To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the proposed minimum variance unbiased approximation of the conditional relative entropy, for multi classification, is: a) an efficient and effective scoring criterion for discriminative learning; b) an unbiased estimate of the CLL, and c) an unbiased estimate for the parameters of the Dirichlet distribution, that maximize the CLL, for Bayesian network classification.

we proposed an efficient approximation to the conditional log likelihood for multi classification tasks that can be used to train augmented Bayesian network classifiers and we provided a closed form equation for the parameters of the Dirichlet distribution that maximizes the scoring criterion.

(i) a minimum variance unbiased estimator to the conditional relative entropies can be obtained; and (ii), for Bayesian network classifiers the parameters that maximize such estimator can be found in closed form, which is a significant contribution in itself.

a new scoring criterion for discriminative learning and parameter estimation of augmented Bayesian network models.
the approximation of the conditional relative entropy, and with its application in the discriminative learning of Bayesian network classifiers.
a general approximation of the CLL, that can be applied in a wide range of applications, and that can be used for discriminative training of Bayesian network classifiers.

the proposed scoring criterion, named aCLL, is an unbiased approximation of CLL, with a closed form solution for the parameters, and it is a good alternative to CLL, especially for large datasets and/or for multi classification tasks, where the exact computation of CLL is not feasible.
the aCLL criterion is a good approximation of the conditional relative entropy, and it has a closed form solution for Bayesian network classifiers.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we provide a new scoring criterion for multi class classification problems and we prove that it is an approximation of the CLL.
we propose an efficient approximation to the conditional log likelihood that can be used for learning Bayesian network classifiers in multi classification problems.
the aCLL is a minimum variance unbiased estimator for the conditional relative entropy.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed approximation is more accurate and computationally less demanding than the exact conditional log-likelihood, which makes it suitable for large datasets and/or large number of features.

the proposed approximation is a very good substitute of the conditional relative entropy, and that it can be used in a variety of discriminative learning algorithms for multi classification tasks and Bayesian network classifiers, such as aCLL and the maximum conditional log likelihood.
, for multi classification problems, the aCLL is a very good approximation for the conditional relative entropy and, as such, can be used to learn classifiers with a good generalization performance.
